outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 2201 singleton births by rural women with mixed risk status in the Nablus region of Palestine between January 2016 and June 2017, comparing those who received the midwife-led model with those who received regular care.
finding: The midwife-led continuity model of care was associated with a statistically significant reduction in unplanned caesarean sections, postpartum anemia, preterm births, NICU admissions, and newborns with birth weight ≤1500 g.
birth_weight: Newborns with birth weight 1500 g and less
